title: Design and evaluation of a multi-epitope DNA vaccine against HPV16.
authors: Zhu, Lanfang; Cui, Xiangjie; Yan, Zhiling; Tao, Yufen; Shi, Lei; Zhang, Xinwen; Yao, Yufeng; Shi, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文设计HPV16多表位DNA疫苗，聚焦免疫原性预测与动物实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cervical cancer, among the deadliest cancers affecting women globally, primarily arises from persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV). To effectively combat persistent infection and prevent the progression of precancerous lesions into malignancy, a therapeutic HPV vaccine is under development. This study utilized an immunoinformatics approach to predict epitopes of cytotoxic T lymphocytes (CTLs) and helper T lymphocytes (HTLs) using the E6 and E7 oncoproteins of the HPV16 strain as target antigens. Subsequently, through meticulous selection of T-cell epitopes and other necessary elements, a multi-epitope vaccine was constructed, exhibiting good immunogenic, physicochemical, and structural characteristics. Furthermore, in silico simulations showed that the vaccine not only interacted well with toll-like receptors (TLR2/TLR3/TLR4), but also induced a strong innate and adaptive immune response characterized by elevated Th1-type cytokines, such as interferon-gamma (IFN-gamma) and interleukin-2 (IL2). Additionally, our study investigated the effects of different immunization intervals on immune responses, aiming to optimize a time-efficient immunization program. In animal model experiments, the vaccine exhibited robust immunogenic, therapeutic, and prophylactic effects. Administered thrice, it consistently induced the expansion of specific CD4 and CD8 T cells, resulting in substantial cytokines release and increased proliferation of memory T cell subsets in splenic cells. Overall, our findings support the potential of this multi-epitope vaccine in combating HPV16 infection and signify its candidacy for future HPV vaccine development.
abstract_zh: 宫颈癌是全球女性中最致命的癌症之一，主要源于高危型人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）的持续感染。为有效对抗持续感染并阻止癌前病变进展为恶性肿瘤，正在开发一种治疗性HPV疫苗。本研究采用免疫信息学方法，以HPV16株的E6和E7癌蛋白作为靶抗原，预测细胞毒性T淋巴细胞（CTLs）和辅助T淋巴细胞（HTLs）的表位。随后，通过精心选择T细胞表位及其他必要元件，构建了一种多表位疫苗，该疫苗表现出良好的免疫原性、理化特性和结构特征。此外，计算机模拟显示，该疫苗不仅与Toll样受体（TLR2/TLR3/TLR4）良好相互作用，还诱导了以Th1型细胞因子（如干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）和白细胞介素-2（IL2））升高为特征的强效先天性和适应性免疫反应。另外，本研究探讨了不同免疫间隔对免疫反应的影响，旨在优化省时的免疫方案。在动物模型实验中，该疫苗表现出强大的免疫原性、治疗性和预防性效果。三次接种后，它持续诱导特异性CD4和CD8 T细胞的扩增，导致脾细胞中大量细胞因子释放和记忆T细胞亚群增殖增加。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持该多表位疫苗在对抗HPV16感染方面的潜力，并表明其作为未来HPV疫苗开发的候选者。
